notes: These exceptions affect publication and highlights only; they do not invent manufacturing values.
A retained negative compatibility/care fact is still useful when explicitly selected; it is not a promotional highlight.

furniture.fixed_height_desks.note: Fixed-height desks have no height-adjustment/folding menu; exclude those fixed absences and NA adjustment ranges. Preserve actual desktop geometry and load.

furniture.folding_space_saving_desks.note: Lead with folding mechanism, usable/folded geometry and mounting conditions; fixed absence of drawers/height adjustment is not a highlight.

furniture.sit_stand_desks.note: Height range/drive/memory are distinctive; fixed absence of folding/drawers is not promotional.

toothbrushes.manual_toothbrushes.note: Manual brush care, head shape and bristle firmness matter; do not list absent motor/app/charging/extras as product features.

toothbrushes.electric_toothbrushes.note: Publish compatibility exclusions with their supported platform when needed; do not use excluded platforms as highlights.

pet_bowls.standard_bowls.note: No feeding obstacles is ordinary bowl anatomy. Material, removable liner/care and nominal capacity remain useful.

pet_bowls.drinking_fountains.note: Publish the water/pump/filter power and care; ordinary absence of feeding obstacles is not a fountain feature.

pet_bowls.raised_feeding_stations.note: Focus on height, removable bowls and materials; no slow-feed obstacles is ordinary station anatomy.

pet_toys.chew_toys.note: Known absence of a puzzle/dispenser is not a chew-toy selling point; do not force every toy into every family function.

pet_toys.soft_toys.note: Plush construction, stuffing, squeaker/catnip and care matter; no food compartment is not promotional.

cookware.woks.note: The wok surface/shape and hob compatibility dominate; optional lid details remain contents/construction.

pots.casserole_dutch_oven_pots.note: Body/coating/capacity and assembled heat suitability dominate; lid material remains a secondary detail.

pots.saucepans.note: Body/base/hob/capacity dominate; lid material stays a detail.

pots.stockpots.note: Capacity/body/hob/care dominate; lid material stays a detail.

footwear.flip_flops.note: A toe-post/slip-on construction is part of product identity; do not promote absence of fastening hardware.

footwear.rubber_boots.note: Pull-on rubber boots need shaft/lining/waterproof declarations, not fastening absence as a headline.
